requirement_match.summary: Two approved purchasing paths implemented; custom legacy retained.

security.summary: Server authority, verified identity, ownership, locked accounts and idempotent verified financial events reviewed/tested.

code_quality.summary: Shared typed policy and schemas; compile, lint, build and proportional tests passed.

failure_paths.summary: Stale/unavailable/invalid/partial payment/refund/hold and unknown response paths checked.

error_handling.summary: No false payment success; persisted operation prevents duplicate order and allows recovery.

production_readiness.summary: Assessment passed: production NOT_READY; no deployment, real prices/provider/auth acceptance absent.

trade_offs.summary: Existing technical QUOTE_ACCEPTED stage reused with catalog display policy; all-inclusive prices required; paginated loaded-subset search disclosed.

findings.summary: Undefined accepted quote version prevented catalog intent persistence
findings.resolution: Persist and compare null for catalog, mocked intent regression passed

findings.summary: Universal deposit/quote/final freight semantics incompatible with catalog full payment
findings.resolution: Shared payment helpers, immutable payable cap and catalog freight policy; legacy retained

findings.summary: Unknown checkout result could create duplicate order after reload
findings.resolution: Persist operation and frozen selection in session; emulator retry readback one order

findings.summary: Catalog was bounded and featured-only; malformed body crashed surface
findings.resolution: Paginated every published item and safe body handling

findings.summary: Ask/CRM wording assumed all orders need quotation/deposit
findings.resolution: Verified catalog source projection and shared adapter helpers

findings.summary: Reload reset visible variant during pending retry
findings.resolution: Restore variant from pending attempt before displaying controls; compiler/build verified

residual_risks: Real listed prices and terms must be configured; no automatic conversion from reference prices.
Live payOS/auth/AI and production deployment acceptance not performed.
Shared dirty worktree includes unrelated changes; no commit or deployment made.
limitations: Final repository intelligence DEGRADED; bounded source/test evidence used.
Browser tests use synthetic emulator data; assistive technology and complete staff UI not certified.
